message: 胸騒ぎの予兆

name: Synn
message: 「Mornin'~~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「News, news! Big news~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Make it some good news, please!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Um, well~ I heard a student teacher is coming tomorrow~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Psh~ Is that all?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't 'is that all' me~ Nobody else knows yet~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, for our class?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmm~ The class next door~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So Misa's class, huh?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「And get this~ She's a female teacher~」

name: Synn
message: 「Oho~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're no fun, Synn-kun~ As a healthy young guy, I was hoping for a more classic reaction from you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if he was interested, she wouldn't give him the time of day.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaat!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get mad just because I hit the nail on the head.」

name: Synn
message: 「Grrr, damn you, Nanaka~~ Keep running your mouth~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you're so sore about it, why don't you go get yourself a girlfriend or two?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A~~ll right. Watch me do just that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No, you can't do that~ Poor Nana-chan would be heartbroken~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, Sacchin! What are you saying all of a sudden!\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oops, my bad. Maybe I should make a run for it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Heyyy! Get back hereee!」

name: Eddie
message: 「Yo. Making quite a racket so early in the morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」
Somehow, I always end up getting brushed off like this....

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~~」

name: Ria
message: 「Hello♪」
Partly because KiraFes had just ended, the Student Council room was overflowing with all kinds of luggage.

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about the calm after the storm.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. Honestly, Synn-kun, you're just like Lolotte-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we start cleaning up first?」

name: Ria
message: 「Then let's carry the big stuff out first~」
Facing each other, we grab opposite ends and lift with our hips.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks for your patronage!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!! Nanaka?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Welco~me♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! What do you think you're making Senpai do?!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean, 'what'? We're carrying boxes--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, you're so clueless! Senpai, don't worry about it. I'll carry this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, eh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just leave heavy lifting like this to yours truly, Nanaka-chan!」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Really? Well then, please do.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I always tell you! When it comes to girls~~. Blah, blah, blah--」
She sure talks a lot while carrying something heavy.

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't you a girl too, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're pulling off being a girl just fine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You actually treat me like a girl too, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you're wearing a skirt.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's your reason!? Then why don't you wear one too, dammit!」

name: Synn
message: 「And also...」
I direct my gaze toward the curves right in front of me.

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, Synn! Even if we're childhood friends, you can't just stare there...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that just goes to show you're a girl too, Nanaka.\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'W-Well'? Even I've got some, you know! Not as big as Ria-senpai's, sure, but... a decent amount, moderately so--uuugh.\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wanna check?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just kidding, you pervert!!」
After finishing carrying the luggage while being teased by Nanaka, everyone cleans up the room together.
In no time at all, it was back to the usual Student Council room.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone. Good work on KiraFes~」

name: Everyone
message: 「Good work!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We adorned our debut match with a splendid victory, didn't we.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course. After all, we are always running down the victory road.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's keep this momentum going and do even more fun stuff.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right now, doesn't it feel like we could get away with anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「For example?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How about getting rid of tests!」

name: Ria
message: 「That might be a little tough.\s02」
So it's not completely impossible.

name: Sally
message: 「Turn Prier into a beef bowl shop!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's impossible.\s02」
So that one is impossible.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's hold KiraFes one more time!」

name: Ria
message: 「KiraFes is nice and all, but when it comes to Student Council activities, December's right around the corner, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is something happening in December?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh right. This is your first Christmas at Ryuusei Academy, Lolo-chan.」

name: Ria
message: 「When you talk about December's main event, it's definitely the Holy Night Festival♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Holy Night Festival!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister last year was... beyond words, simply magnificent.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「You worked really hard in the choir too, Misa-chan.」

name: Sally
message: 「In the higher?」

name: Misa
message: 「Not higher! C-h-o-i-r!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's where you sing hymns and stuff to celebrate Christmas, right.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's an annual tradition, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「So since we're on the Student Council this year, we'll be on the organizing side, huh.」

name: Ria
message: 「We still have two whole months left, so let's take our time figuring out how to run it.\s04」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, totally.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Holy Night Festival, huh~~. Somehow I'm getting all excited~~」
At that time, however, none of us had any way of knowing that something far more troublesome awaited us even before the Holy Night Festival.
